title: THE SHIRT — A RONALDO STORY
centralQuestion: What remains when Portugal’s number seven passes on?

scenes.title: THE FIRST STAGE
scenes.narration: Sporting gave him his first senior stage in 2002. The game became faster and the space tighter. A pass needed the right weight. A run needed the right moment. His talent now had to work with teammates, against players who wanted the same ball.

scenes.title: THE WEIGHT OF SEVEN
scenes.narration: United signed him in 2003. A teenager inherited the number seven shirt, carrying expectations before he had earned his own place in the club's history. He arrived as a winger, full of speed and invention. Over the following seasons, the goals became as important as the tricks. In 2008, United won the Champions League and Ronaldo received his first Ballon d'Or. Teammates had helped turn an individual talent into a champion. His next move took him to Madrid.

scenes.title: ABOVE THE GAME
scenes.narration: Real Madrid brought him to Spain in 2009. In white, he became the club's record scorer and helped win four Champions League titles. Turin, 2018. Even the Juventus supporters stood to applaud that finish. For a moment, rivalry gave way to appreciation. They had come to support another team, yet this visiting player had made them rise to their feet. That response became part of the memory of his bicycle kick.

scenes.title: A COUNTRY, TOGETHER
scenes.narration: Portugal's story belonged to a team. The European title came in 2016. Nations League wins followed in 2019 and 2025. Ronaldo became men's international football's record scorer. On November fifth, twenty twenty-six, he announced his international retirement. His club career continues. The farewell is to this shirt, and to the teammates and supporters who made it mean something.
